# Aman Yadav — Mobile & AI-Native Developer

Aman Yadav is a mobile application developer and AI-native software engineer from Janakpur, Nepal, and the owner of amanyadav.site. He builds high-performance cross-platform mobile applications and integrates generative AI directly into software architectures.

## Skills
- Mobile: Flutter, Dart, React Native, Kotlin
- AI: Generative AI, LLM integration, AI-first architecture
- Cloud: Supabase, Firebase, serverless backends
- Web: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML/CSS
